heading: LESSON OBJECTIVE
text: Calculate cylinder volume and surface area using radius and height.

heading: CORE IDEA
text: A cylinder has two equal circular bases joined by a curved side.

heading: KEY DEFINITIONS
text: Radius is half the diameter. Height is perpendicular between the circular bases.

heading: CORE RULE
text: Volume is pi times radius squared times height. Closed surface area is 2 pi r squared plus 2 pi r h.
